finding.claim: Broken authorization on the ban endpoint. require_admin() denies access by raising werkzeug's HTTPException through abort(403). ban() wraps that call in `except Exception`, which catches the exception and only logs a warning. Execution then continues to do_ban(uid), so any authenticated non-admin user can ban any user.
finding.source: Any authenticated non-admin user sends POST /admin/users/<uid>/ban with an arbitrary uid.
finding.sink: do_ban(uid) at admin.py:20, a privileged operation.

trace.note: Route /admin/users/<uid>/ban accepts POST and the uid is attacker-controlled.
require_admin(g.user) is called inside a try block.
A non-admin user triggers abort(403), which raises HTTPException (a subclass of Exception).
Only a warning is logged. There is no re-raise and no return.
do_ban(uid) runs anyway and the endpoint returns ok=True.

finding.guards_checked: The only guard is require_admin, and the broad except nullifies it. There is no other decorator, before_request hook or check in the file. The sibling endpoint unban() calls require_admin without a try/except, so it is correctly protected. The log line also writes the user's name, which is minor.

verdict.guard_found: require_admin (admin.py:9-11) aborts with 403 for non-admins, but ban() wraps it in try/except Exception (admin.py:16-19), so the error is swallowed. There is no before_request hook or decorator in the file.
verdict.reason: admin.py:17 calls require_admin, which raises through abort(403) at admin.py:11. admin.py:18 `except Exception` catches it, admin.py:19 only logs, and admin.py:20 do_ban(uid) runs for any authenticated non-admin. The trace has minor line offsets: the abort is on line 11, not 10. These do not change the outcome.

verdict_facts.guard_found: require_admin (admin.py:9-11) aborts with 403 for non-admins, but the abort is caught by `except Exception` at admin.py:18. No decorator, before_request hook or other check exists, and admin.py is the only file.
verdict_facts.reason: At admin.py:17-20, require_admin's abort(403) (admin.py:11) is an HTTPException that `except Exception` (admin.py:18) swallows with only a log call, with no re-raise or return, so do_ban(uid) at admin.py:20 runs for any authenticated non-admin.
